_about: Comic B balloon, caption and lettering geometry: the measured recipe of assets/reference-balloons/report.md (shapes.json, 68 shapes on 7 reference pages, 2026-09-29), one swappable config read by the engine through ComicStory.astro. Unit c = the cap height of the balloon's own lettering (measured from the face at run time). Change values here, in both skill editions, never in code.
approved: Matt, 2026-10-02 (2.1.0 accepted; spec "Comic B: balloon standard 2.1.0 accepted")
_approvedNote: The approved standard: 2.0.0 (Matt, 2026-09-29: 'looks perfect. standardize ...'), refined to 2.1.0 (Matt, 2026-09-30: 'refine to 95', 'Kalam lettering') and accepted on 2026-10-02 ('Accept 2.1.0') at Codex 94 as the baseline. Frozen with renders and measured parameters in assets/golden/ (site/scripts/comic-story-golden.mjs), the regression reference; a change needs Matt's approval, a new version here and a re-captured golden.
_source: assets/reference-balloons/report.md (recipe 1-11) and shapes.json (speech, shaken, burst, caption, lettering aggregates; usage table).

lettering._note: Dialogue cap height about 1.2% of the page's SHORT side (shapes.json lettering.cap_height_frac_of_page_width, median 0.012, measured on portrait pages whose width is their short side; Matt, 2026-09-29: 'chat bubbles have regressed significantly' when it was applied to our wide page's width), never under a readable 9 px cap (about 13 px type); baseline to baseline 1.31c (1.11-1.53); about 9 characters a line (5-15), 2-7 lines (median 3); the first and last lines about 0.8 of the widest; lines composed so the body's a/b stays in 0.9-2.1 without inflating it. Shouts 1.6x (the references: 1.6-3.5x).
lettering._floorNote: Readable floor (Matt, 2026-09-29: 'don't make too small'): dialogue type at least 15 px on a desktop page and 14 px on a phone; tighten with padding, shape and stroke, never by shrinking type below it.

marvel._cite: X-Men #137, Spider-Man #33, Avengers: rounded-rectangle balloons n 3.5-6 (shapes.json speech n p75 4.4, p90 5.8); 4.5 for the squarer, tighter Marvel look (Matt, 2026-09-29: 'savage and tight'); caption #eae619 (X-Men 137)

crisis._cite: Crisis #8, AllTime #15: fat ovals n 2.0-2.8; cream caption #f9ddb6 (Crisis 8)

_lookNote: One look per issue (the story's `look`, default marvel); ?look=crisis previews the other.

speech._note: Tight (Matt, 2026-09-29: 'make more savage and tight'): a = textW/2 + 0.6c, b = textH/2 + 0.6c, the low end of the measured range (padX p10 0.51, padY p10 0.60; median 0.94/0.75); a/b within 0.9-2.1 by composing the lines, never by inflating; shoulders r = max(r_superellipse, r_textHull + 0.45c); hand variation 1 + sum_k A_k cos(k theta + phi_k), k 2-4, A 1.2-2%. Outline 0.20c, black.
speech._aspectNote: a/b up to 2.3 when composing (the references' 0.9-2.1 was measured with their median padding, 0.94c x 0.75c; at the tighter approved padding the same blocks measure wider). The silhouette IoU is the check.

tail._note: One path with the body: exit nearest the mouth, two quadratics from root +-0.48c to the tip, controls at 45% of the length 0.22c off the axis, 0.3c fillets, bend at most 5 degrees (median 2).

offPanelTail._cite: X-Men #132 PIERCE, WYNGARDE (crops/ref-13.png): a long thin tail to the panel edge

weakTail._cite: Darkseid page NO. (crops/ref-56.png): a zigzag tail for a faint reply

butted._cite: X-Men #137 bottom tier (crops/ref-8.png): cut flat by the border, no outline on the cut side

chain._cite: X-Men #137 OH, JEAN (crops/ref-10.png), Avengers (crops/ref-43.png): a neck 1-1.5c wide, 0.5-1c long; only the last balloon has a tail

across._cite: Avengers BUT, NOBODY ... NOBODY! (crops/ref-40.png): a connector across the gutter to the next panel's balloon

fear._cite: Avengers MY HEAD'S SPINNING (crops/ref-44.png, ref-45.png, ref-47.png): a scalloped speech balloon, about 14 bumps (8-17), roughness 0.104c. Matt's fear balloon, as the references draw it.

burst._cite: Darkseid NO!! (crops/ref-50.png), AllTime panic (crops/ref-57.png, ref-58.png, ref-65.png), X-Men #137 red scream (crops/ref-12.png)
burst._note: Closer to the reference averages (Matt, 2026-09-30: 'refine to 95'): the references' bursts are wide, near-rectangular bodies ringed by many short teeth (shapes.json burst samples). Tuned by the silhouette IoU against them (every lab burst at least 0.78, searched offline over body, padding, tooth count and length with the style check's metric): a superellipse body (n 4.5) at 0.9c x 0.5c around the lettering, 10-13 straight teeth 0.3-0.6c out from valleys 5% inside the body, the tail tooth at most 0.6c. The report's tip lengths for bursts were visual estimates (its Limits); the IoU is the measurement.
burst._voicesNote: Per voice (Codex style check 33: the three bursts should differ): a scream has fewer, longer points; panic broader planes, fewer points and one long point toward the speaker (the AllTime panic crops). Kept inside the IoU floor.

menace._cite: X-Men #132 NOW IT'S MY TURN! (crops/ref-15.png): a red wavy second outline

characterIntro._note: Matt, 2026-10-09: identifying character captions use the site brand teal, with the unchanged caption fillAlpha (0.85). Narration/place retain their look-specific fill; the 2.1.0 geometry and other balloon styles stay unchanged.

caption._note: Square corners, a black rule about 0.2c, padding left 0.67c, right 0.78c, top 0.60c, bottom 0.77c, baseline pitch 1.29c; butted into a box corner (flush to its border) or run as a band; stacked 0.5c apart. Fill #eae619 (X-Men 137) or #f9ddb6 (Crisis 8) by look. Captions are the square yellow boxes; balloons are white #f4f4f4, except thinking (the yellow balloon with the bead stem). A caption never breaks a word: a cascade inset grows up to 1.5x inside its host, or the caption moves to the host.
caption._aspectNote: Captions keep near the references' proportions (1.1-2.0 wide to high, or a full-width band of 5 and more; shapes.json caption samples): the composer adds lines until the box is at most 2.6 wide to high, never leaving a stray one-word line.
caption._sizeNote: Caption lettering at the dialogue size (Matt, 2026-09-29: 'make yellow square text bigger than you are demoing now'): at least 15 px on a desktop page, 14 px on a phone.

fillAlpha._note: Matt, 2026-09-28: 'some transparency in those yellow and other bubbles would be worth it' - a deliberate deviation from print. Outlines and lettering stay fully opaque; no blur.

iou._note: The style check's silhouette IoU against the reference outlines (shapes.json samples, same kind): every balloon at least 0.78, the page median at least 0.85 (the references against each other: p25 0.78, median 0.86).

_fillNote: The measured reference balloon fill: neutral near-white, median #f4f4f4 over the reference balloons (assets/reference-balloons/shapes.raw-per-shape.json; range #f1f0f0-#f9f9f7). Matt, 2026-09-29: 'i want the speech bubbles to match the reference images. i think you invented the color change.' Never re-tinted to match the page paper (historical #f8f2e4; current margins, frames and gutters use brand teal #1a9ba1). The paper grain shows inside balloons, mean-preserving (their rendered mean stays #f4f4f4 within 1 level; the style check's mean test).
_grainNote: The paper grain inside balloons and captions at a fifth of the sampled paper's strength (about +-0.7 level, at most 2.3): nearly invisible and mean-preserving; the style check's mean test holds every balloon within 1 level of its measured fill.

thought._note: Thinking is the one yellow balloon: the measured yellow of Spider-Man #33's thought balloons (shapes.raw-per-shape.json ids 34, 35: #ede614, #eee714; crops ref-34.png, ref-35.png), the same body as speech, and always the bead stem: 2-3 small beads (0.5, 0.36, 0.25c high) shrinking toward the thinker, never a wedge (Matt, 2026-09-29: 'we need to make the white bubbles standard. we can have yellow bubbles, and that can indicate something like thinking, the stem of the bubble should standardize that'). The references' yellow balloons carry wedge tails; the bead stem is Matt's exception. White #f4f4f4 is the standard for every other voice.

_changes: 2.0.1 (2026-09-29, engine): artifact fixes from Codex style check 8, not style changes: a butted caption shares the box border (no doubled frame); a breakout's paper is opaque over the rules and gutters it crosses; the balloon grain at 0.2 of the paper's strength (was 0.25) so every balloon's mean stays within 1 level. For Matt's glance.

2.1.0 (2026-09-30): Matt's 'Yes, refine to 95' and 'Kalam lettering'. Kalam 700 (stress slanted and heavier); speech padding 0.75c x 0.65c, outline 0.12c, leading 1.35c; fear on a rounder body (n 2.5) with 12-17 uneven lobes about 1c wide and 0.3c deep; a slim zigzag weak tail with round joins; a tapered across connector (0.5c to 0.14c); a slim off-panel root; bursts wide with short teeth and two accents (tuned by the silhouette IoU), fewer and longer points for scream and panic; sharp mitred tail tips; a breakout's paper opaque throughout; captions with a whole-pixel rule. Style check 43 (Codex): lettering 94, balloons 93, captions 96, colour 97, geometry 93, no inventions. Accepted by Matt on 2026-10-02 as the baseline (Codex 94). IoU median 0.868, minimum 0.797.

2026-10-02: Matt: 'Accept 2.1.0'. The accepted baseline is style check 43 (Codex: lettering 94, balloons 93, captions 96, colour 97, geometry 93; no inventions; IoU median 0.868, minimum 0.797). Golden 2.1.0 is the regression reference.
